content:
emily: Noticed a regression on compact dashboards: x-axis labels truncate and unit disappears at narrow widths. Hover shows unit but keyboard/ScreenReader users lose it.

zack: Repro at 375px with 2 columns. Labels become `1.2k…` — unit missing.

leila: Proposal: visual micro-unit under axis (small, consistent) + full unit preserved in aria-label on axis container (aria-hidden on visual).

ravi: Also: stop auto-smoothing on narrow; if smoothing applied show a small 'Smoothed' badge and provide toggle. Announce changes via aria-live.

a11y-bot: Checklist: axis tabindex=0, aria-label="{fullLabel} {unit}", visual micro-label aria-hidden, live region for smoothing toggle, tooltip keyboard focusable.

emily: Outliers: use a sentinel marker at clip edge + accessible tooltip with original value and a mini sparkline. Avoid inset charts in compact view.

zack: Dev note: prefer shared overlay for units if perf problems appear.

leila: I'll update Figma; Ravi will prototype CSS and aria copy. QA: test NVDA/VoiceOver at desktop/tablet/mobile.
